propositions: The ops error-sweep ledger convention for passing last-sweep timeline across debugging-orchestration sessions is currently undocumented, preventing reliable discovery and extension by future sessions.
Documentation must specify that session_log is the correct carrier because it is excluded from default list, ready/next-batch, graph-health, and never syncs to Jira, creating zero work-queue noise.

The convention documentation must cover: ledger id/alias, ops-sweep tag, discovery via search, SWEEP header with ISO-8601 timestamp and window rule, appending via rebar comment, linking filed tickets with relates_to, and recreation procedure.
AGENTS.md must be extended with a one-line pointer to the ops error-sweep ledger convention as documented in docs/user-guide.md, following the policy that already-documented topics are pointers only.
The new subsection in docs/user-guide.md must be placed under the existing Session logs section and match the mechanics described in docs/event-schema.md regarding session_log ticket type behavior.
